verdict.rationale: Mistral exposes a broad API surface: conversations, structured outputs, function calling, Agents API with built-in tools (document library, web search, code interpreter, image generation, handoffs), batch, moderation guardrails, model listing, and official Python/TypeScript SDKs. However, nothing documents parity with the UI. Usage, spend, and Workspace caps are described through a dashboard, community users report API docs missing OCR endpoint details, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the standard paths. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, API access to admin/usage/limits management, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and complete OCR endpoint documentation.
